description: Build a Ready story or bug in a worktree with checkpoint commits per layer, verify each checkpoint, and open a PR.

asked.description: The person's own words asking for this story. An agent needs them to pick up a Ready story that did not come out of grill in this session; without them build stops with a warning before taking the story.

decline.description: Decline open items of the last session review, one "<id>: <why>" a line; the reason goes into the PR's session review summary, and the merge gate's inspect still judges them.

delegate.description: Hand the story to another agent's cloud agent with the delegation brief, or sync it: its PR, inspect's findings, and follow-ups (auto picks the cheapest adequate connected one).

issue.description: Ready story or bug to build.

local.description: With --delegate: run the receiver's CLI on this machine in an aayu worktree, with no GitHub credential; aayu commits, verifies, pushes, and opens the PR.

resume.description: Resume from the last Aayudha-Checkpoint trailer.

title: build
